fields.finding: The reported 37.31646143905225 m3 honeycomb void is recovered by subtracting full-area AF volume 0.2945010968475796 m3 and core splice volume 0.012181226862401973 m3 from A*t_core-core_mass/2700. Without that unstated placement convention the independent values are 37.62314376276223 m3, 43.744289548973256 kg trapped air, and 0.8946683119525318 of the gas allowance, versus filed 37.31646143905225 m3, 43.38771114998258 kg and 0.887375488189865. This is an unresolved manufactured-section convention, not a discrepancy in the quoted endurance calculation.
fields.proposed_next: Specify the reference core envelope and measured adhesive/fillet/splice displacements. Keep the two interpretations separate until a manufactured section establishes them.
